{"note": "d13 Sun 09:56: bedroom_floor_b3 held wallet_sofia; resident_3 present. Contradicts belief 5 (floors not storage). Wallets are small, portable items that can be dropped or placed on floors, unlike bulky gear. Floors are volatile for small personal items (wallets/keys) but stable-empty for bulky gear (backpacks/jackets).", "fork": {"beliefs": "1. Counter_k1 is the primary stable drop-zone for daily gear (backpacks, jackets, water bottles) and volatile for mugs. Evidence: d12 09:22, 10:06, 11:16, 11:25 consistently show backpacks/jackets/bottles; mugs appear/disappear randomly.
2. Nightstands (b1, b3) are stable homes for personal electronics (phones, chargers) and specific accessories (glasses, meds) when residents are absent or in that room. Evidence: d12 11:25 (Mara), d13 09:49 (Sofia).
3. Kitchen receptacles (sink, dish_rack) hold stable cookware (pots, pans, plates) and volatile personal items (mugs, lunchboxes). Evidence: d12 11:16.
4. Specialized items stay in designated living room spots (game_shelf for controllers). Evidence: d12 10:10.
5. Bedroom floors are not storage for bulky gear (backpacks/jackets) but are volatile spots for small portable items (wallets, keys) that may be dropped or placed there. Evidence: d13 09:56 (wallet_sofia on floor_b3).
6. Objects are rarely misplaced; patterns are highly consistent. Misplacements are rare exceptions, not the norm.", "why": "Belief 5 stated floors are not storage locations for personal gear. The look at bedroom_floor_b3 revealed wallet_sofia, a small personal item, contradicting the absolute exclusion of personal items from floors. Updated belief 5 to distinguish between bulky gear (stable-empty on floors) and small portable items (volatile presence on floors)."}}
